name: Claude accounts
author: Brett
description: Claude accounts on the VPS: lists the saved logins and API keys, switches the console's account, and routes headless jobs: every subscription login is a worker (the console's account takes jobs after them), 3 build and 5 wait per account, and API-key accounts take only the jobs a routing rule sends them, under daily and weekly spend caps with alerts. Job routing settings: rules on job type, model, size, priority, profile and a subscriptions-busy fallback, in order, each on or off, with a test-a-job preview. Never shows a credential. Every switch, save, sign-in or removal is one held axHub call.

items.title: List Claude accounts
items.description: The Claude logins and API keys saved on the VPS: name, type, which is active, email and plan. Never a credential.

items.title: Active Claude account
items.description: Which saved Claude account new launches use.

items.title: Switch Claude account
items.description: Switch Claude on the VPS to a saved account (voice: 'switch Claude to account 2'; name 'account 2' works). Sends one held axHub call: Brett approves or denies it. Running builds keep their account; new launches use the active one.

name.description: saved account name, 1 to 32 lower-case letters, digits or dashes

items.title: Make a Claude account a worker or stop it
items.description: Every saved subscription login takes headless jobs unless stopped. role worker = takes jobs again, saved = stop it (voice: 'stop account 1 taking jobs'). The console's own account and API keys have their own settings under Job routing.

role.description: worker, or saved to take it back

items.title: Sign a Claude account in
items.description: Start the sign-in for a new or expired account in its own folder, so the active login isn't touched. Sends one held axHub call; the sign-in then opens in the Terminal for Brett to finish.

name.description: account name, 1 to 32 lower-case letters, digits or dashes

items.title: Remove a saved Claude account
items.description: Set a saved account aside: its folder moves to .removed on the VPS, nothing is deleted. Refused for the active account or one running a job. Sends one held axHub call.

items.title: Save the current Claude login
items.description: Save the login Claude is signed in with on the VPS under a name. Sends one held axHub call: Brett approves or denies it.

name.description: name to save it as, 1 to 32 lower-case letters, digits or dashes

items.title: Show Claude job routing
items.description: Which accounts take headless jobs: each account's role, running and queued jobs against its limits, cost today and this week, API spend caps and alerts, and the routing rules in order.

items.title: Test where a job would go
items.description: Preview which Claude account a job would run on right now and which rule decided it (voice: 'where would a small Opus walkthrough go'). Nothing is launched.

items.title: Change Claude job routing settings
items.description: Whether the console's own account also takes headless jobs (after the workers), and how many jobs build (default 3) and wait (default 5) per account.

items.title: Change a Claude job routing rule
items.description: Add, update, remove, move (up, down or a position) or switch on/off a rule that sends jobs to API accounts or keeps them on subscriptions. The first matching rule wins.

accounts.description: API accounts this rule may use ([] = any)

when.description: when the rule applies; every list empty = any

jobTypes.description: build, agent-job or a job-type id (walkthrough, ui-shots…)

subs.description: busy = only while no subscription account can start the job now (fallback)

to.description: move: up, down or a position

items.title: Set up a Claude API account
items.description: Add an API-key account as a worker with its daily and weekly spend caps, change its caps or alert level, switch it on or off, or remove it. A session can lower a cap but only Brett's own click raises or removes one. The key itself is saved on the VPS (claude-account savekey <name>), never here.

alertAt.description: 0.1-1, share of a cap that raises an alert (default 0.8)

items.title: Replace the Claude job routing config
items.description: Write the whole routing config (claude-workers@1) at once. Same cap rule as routing-api.

items.title: Name a Claude account
items.description: Give a saved account a display name (voice: 'call account 3 Hulu').

keeps: /root/.claude-accounts and /usr/local/bin/claude-account on the VPS host: the saved logins and the script belong to the host, not to this plugin
